candidates.title: IronGrip Pro Work Gloves
reviews: Uncomfortable and stiff, but they have survived two years of welding work.
Bulky fit, yet the leather has not torn once.
Hate the sizing, still they outlast everything else I've owned.

candidates.title: SoftHands Comfort Work Gloves
reviews: So comfortable, like a second skin!
Great feel and dexterity, very soft.
The seams ripped within a week though.

expected.trap: overall-sentiment average would pick b; the judge must isolate durability only
